title: Python stdlib collection trajectory delta skill
applies_when: candidate path is one of src/collection_tools.py
starter function matches one of chunked_list, dedupe_preserve_order, flatten_one_level, rotate, windowed

evidence.public_prompt: Implement src/collection_tools.py with chunked_list(items, size). Return a list of list chunks of length size. Include a final shorter chunk. Raise ValueError when size is not positive. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/collection_tools.py with dedupe_preserve_order(items). Return a list with duplicate items removed while preserving first-seen order. Items are hashable. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/collection_tools.py with flatten_one_level(items). Flatten one nesting level from an iterable of iterables. Strings should be treated as scalar values, not expanded into characters. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/collection_tools.py with rotate(items, amount). Return a new list rotated left by amount positions. Negative amount rotates right. Empty input returns an empty list. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/collection_tools.py with windowed(items, size). Return a list of tuples representing sliding windows of length size. Raise ValueError when size is not positive. If size is larger than the input, return an empty list. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

title: Python stdlib parse trajectory delta skill
applies_when: candidate path is one of src/parse_tools.py
starter function matches one of parse_bool, parse_env_lines, parse_query_string, parse_semver, parse_size_bytes

evidence.public_prompt: Implement src/parse_tools.py with parse_bool(value). Parse common boolean strings. Return True for true, yes, y, 1, on. Return False for false, no, n, 0, off. Matching is case-insensitive after stripping. Raise ValueError otherwise. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/parse_tools.py with parse_env_lines(text). Parse .env-style lines into a dict. Ignore blank lines and lines starting with #. Split on the first equals sign. Strip surrounding whitespace from keys and values. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/parse_tools.py with parse_query_string(query). Parse a URL query string into a dict mapping each key to a list of decoded values. Ignore a leading ?. Use urllib.parse semantics for percent decoding and blank values. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/parse_tools.py with parse_semver(value). Parse a semantic version string MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional leading v. Return a tuple of three integers. Reject missing parts, non-integers, or negative numbers with ValueError. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/parse_tools.py with parse_size_bytes(value). Parse an integer size string with optional binary unit suffix B, KB, MB, or GB. Units are case-insensitive and use powers of 1024. Reject decimals, negative numbers, and unknown units with ValueError. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

title: Python stdlib path trajectory delta skill
applies_when: candidate path is one of src/path_tools.py
starter function matches one of common_prefix_path, extension_counts, is_subpath, normalize_segments, split_filename_version

evidence.public_prompt: Implement src/path_tools.py with common_prefix_path(paths). Return the common path prefix using POSIX path semantics. Return an empty string for no paths. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/path_tools.py with extension_counts(paths). Return a dict counting lowercase file extensions from paths. Use an empty string for paths with no suffix. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/path_tools.py with is_subpath(parent, child). Return True if child is inside parent or equal to parent after POSIX path normalization. Treat paths as absolute or relative strings. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/path_tools.py with normalize_segments(path). Normalize dot and double-slash segments in a POSIX-style path without allowing the result to escape above root for relative paths. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/path_tools.py with split_filename_version(name). Split names like report-v12.txt into ('report', 12, '.txt'). If no -v<number> suffix appears before the extension, return (stem, None, suffix). Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.
